label: Claude Haiku 5.5
output:
**Title:** Good value, but it was late and something got chipped

Moved from Phibsborough to Drumcondra on Saturday 17 October. It was a 2-bed flat, but most of it was my stuff, and the new place is a 4th floor walk-up with no lift. I used Kilbarrack Van Co after getting a few quotes, and overall I'd use them again. I'm giving 4 stars because of two specific things that went wrong.

Booking was easy. I went through their website and paid the €50 deposit by Revolut. The quote was €340 for up to 4 hours with two lads and the van. The job took about 3.5 hours, so it came in under the time limit, and the price was the best I found. The other quotes I got were over €450.

The main problem was timing. I was booked for 9am and they arrived around 10:30. They texted at 8:40 to say the previous job had overrun, which was useful to know, but I was still sitting on boxes for over an hour and a half. For most people this would be an annoyance. If you have a tight handover with a landlord or a fixed key collection time, it could cause real trouble. Build in some buffer if you're on a deadline, and if you can, ask them to confirm the start time the evening before.

When I got to the third floor, the couch wouldn't go around the turn on the stairwell. One of the lads took the legs off with an Allen key from his pocket and it went straight through. I was impressed by how quickly that was sorted. Most of the rest of the move was handled well. Everything else was wrapped in blankets, and they put the bed back together without being asked. They also took away a flat-pack shelf I didn't want to bring.

The one real loss was the brass base of a floor lamp that belonged to my nanny. It got chipped. It was wrapped in the other items' blankets but not that one. I'm not blaming anyone too hard, since things happen on a move, but if you have anything fragile with sentimental value, wrap it yourself or tell the crew directly and make sure they do it. I should have said something more specific before they started.

They did knock €40 off the price for the late arrival without me asking, which I appreciated. It showed they took the delay seriously and weren't just hoping I'd forget.

So the summary: good value, a friendly and capable crew, and a quick fix for the couch problem. The late arrival and the lamp are the reasons it's not five stars. If you're moving, plan around possible delays, wrap anything that matters to you yourself, and say so clearly before they start loading.
